children.text: Electron app, which provides opportunity to generate images in node-based canvas

canvas AC:

- core features:
    - zoom
    - pan
    - support mouse & wheel
    - support touch (reference - excalidraw)
    - support Mac & Windows keyboard for hotkeys

- 5 types of nodes:
    - text node
    - image prompt generator node
    - image prompt node
    - image codegen node
    - image node

- general node AC:
    - node could be dragged
    - node content could be copied (cmd + C or ctrl + C)
    - hotkey ctl+C for image -> image node being created
    - right click -> node creation
    - user can create nodes by right click: text node, image prompt generator node, image generator node
    - user can copy content from nodes: text node, image prompt node, image node
    - text nodes and whole graph are stored as json in working dir
    - image prompts strored separately in corresponding file under `node_id.md` in folder `prompts/`
    - images stored separately in corresponding file under `node_id.png` in folder `images/`
    - each node could be deleted
    - if image prompt node being deleted, it corresponding file should be deleted too
    - if image node being deleted, it corresponding file should be deleted too

- text node AC:
    - provides input for user to write

- image prompt generator node:
    - have socket for taking input from one or more text node
    - have button start (rerun)
    - automatically creates image prompt node on run
    - on rerun output being overrided

- image prompt node
    - always being created by image prompt generator node and cannot be unlinked from it
    - shows text of created prompt
    - text of prompt is truncated
    - there should be button "show more" / "show less"

- image generator node:
  - provides select for specifying model (chatgpt images, recraft, nano banana 2, nano banana pro)
    - provides select for specifying dimensions
    - have socket for applying text or images as input
    - have button start (rerun)
    - automatically creates image node node on run
    - on rerun new image node being created


- image node:
    - renders image

tech decisions:
- use anthropic agentic SDK for spawning agents and do actual work
- write internal skills for image prompt generator & image generator nodes, which specifies rules for storing prompts and images in working dir
- use magnific MCP for image generation

also "tab" is required:
- each tab - one working dir
- when user creates new tab (e.g. canvas), app requests to define working dir on the local system of the user
- working dir have `prompts/` and `images/` which are have flat structure
